question: What explains the N225 event: Japan-local factor, regional Asia co-move, US/global risk, JPY, policy, or fundamentals?
next_best_evidence: PIT-aligned same-day Asia returns plus PRIOR US-session returns/VIX/USDJPY
why: It separates a Japan/regional Asia shock from a US-global lead without lookahead
source: GOE prices DB (yahoo), completed daily bars
period: event 2026-11-06; prior US session 2026-11-05; trailing 90 sessions

decision_rule.global: prior US session SPY < -1% AND VIX > 0
decision_rule.reversal: N225 cumulative return over next 3 sessions > 0
decision_rule.alignment: Asia same-day; US/FX previous US session; no same-date future US close

pit_note: US same-calendar-date close is after the Asia close and is therefore not used.
